name: beset_ship
notes: An old polar expedition barquentine, 53 m overall with the bowsprit and 7.75 m in the beam, caught in the cove ice and abandoned: a curved hull standing 5.5 m out of the floe with a raised poop, pressure ridges along both sides, masts leaning to starboard and sails frozen on the yards. Door in the poop's forward wall and in the deckhouse's aft wall (1 m by 2 m), stairs to the poop and down to the lower deck, which has 2.25 m headroom. Long axis local X, bow at +X; `base: sea`.
